preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access fee manipulation functions
Contract must have sufficient token balance for swap and liquify mechanism to trigger

exploit_hint: 1. As owner, call excludeFromFee(attacker_address) to exempt attacker from transfer fees. 2. Call setTaxFeePercent(), setLiquidityFeePercent(), and setCharityFeePercent() to set maximum allowed fees (total up to 25%). 3. Set _charityAddress to attacker's address to receive charity fees. 4. Trigger transfers from other users to the contract or through the contract. 5. Attacker receives fees from all transfers while paying no fees themselves, effectively draining value from other users' transactions.
